name: Question cards
purpose: 2-3 open questions to reflect on or discuss, each on its own card.

cards.title: Energy
cards.question: What gave you energy this week, and what drained it?

cards.title: Growth
cards.question: Which skill do you want to practice next?

cards.title: Support
cards.question: What's one thing I could do to help?

example_beats.say: Before your next one-on-one, think about three questions.
What gave you energy, which skill you want to practice, and how I can help.
